summary: Samples a Render TOP or Render Pass TOP at UV coordinates and returns 3D pick data such as position, normal, color, UVs, depth, and pick state channels.
key_concepts: Render Pick CHOP samples a Render TOP or Render Pass TOP and returns 3D information at a UV pick location.
Returned data can include picked state, trigger state, position, normals, point color, texture coordinates, object path, depth, instance ID, and custom attributes.
Pick location can come from a Panel COMP's mouse UVs or from explicit U, V, and Select parameters.
Strategy controls whether values update while selected, hold the first pick, hold the last pick, or update continuously.
Response Time trades off speed and latency: Next Cook is faster but returns previous-frame results, while This Cook is slower.
Use an Info DAT referencing the Render Pick CHOP when the picked object path is needed.

common_gotchas: Use an Info DAT to retrieve picked object paths when path output is enabled.
This Cook response is slower; use Next Cook when one-frame latency is acceptable.
Picking depends on a compatible render output and pick coordinates in the rendered image.
The picked channel is 1 only when geometry is found at the search location; trigger also requires the panel value or Select condition.
Using pickable flags restricts selection to pickable geometry; including non-pickable objects can still let them occlude pickable objects.
Render Pick DAT is the official multi-sample alternative when many pick samples are needed.
